command_line:
set -eu
h5dump -d /obs/_index "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79145090/inputs/dataset_dab0e3df-16eb-4d1e-b4c8-99ebf67226d5.dat" | grep -o '"[ACGT][ACGT][ACGT][ACGT][ACGT][ACGT][ACGT][ACGT][ACGT][ACGT][ACGT][ACGT][ACGT][ACGT][ACGT][ACGT]-[0-9]"' | tr -d '"' > h5_barcodes.txt
h5dump -d /var/_index "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79145090/inputs/dataset_dab0e3df-16eb-4d1e-b4c8-99ebf67226d5.dat" | grep -o '"ENSMUSG[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]"' | tr -d '"' > h5_genes.txt
cp "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79145090/inputs/dataset_b38fefbf-4dec-49c3-93f3-f4d55913c04d.dat" geo_barcodes.txt
cp "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79145090/inputs/dataset_376ef863-3fe0-4d6c-9fee-c5a4d28c5533.dat" geo_genes.txt
sort h5_barcodes.txt > h5_barcodes.sorted
sort geo_barcodes.txt > geo_barcodes.sorted
sort h5_genes.txt > h5_genes.sorted
sort geo_genes.txt > geo_genes.sorted
comm -12 h5_barcodes.sorted geo_barcodes.sorted > barcode_intersection.txt
comm -23 h5_barcodes.sorted geo_barcodes.sorted > barcode_h5_only.txt
comm -13 h5_barcodes.sorted geo_barcodes.sorted > barcode_geo_only.txt
comm -12 h5_genes.sorted geo_genes.sorted > gene_intersection.txt
comm -23 h5_genes.sorted geo_genes.sorted > gene_h5_only.txt
comm -13 h5_genes.sorted geo_genes.sorted > gene_geo_only.txt
{
  echo 'h5ad_shape_cells_genes=20072x28692'
  printf 'h5_barcodes_count='; wc -l < h5_barcodes.txt
  printf 'geo_barcodes_count='; wc -l < geo_barcodes.txt
  printf 'barcode_intersection_count='; wc -l < barcode_intersection.txt
  printf 'barcode_h5_only_count='; wc -l < barcode_h5_only.txt
  printf 'barcode_geo_only_count='; wc -l < barcode_geo_only.txt
  echo 'h5_barcodes_first5'; head -n 5 h5_barcodes.txt
  echo 'geo_barcodes_first5'; head -n 5 geo_barcodes.txt
  echo 'barcode_geo_only_first10'; head -n 10 barcode_geo_only.txt
  printf 'h5_genes_count='; wc -l < h5_genes.txt
  printf 'geo_genes_count='; wc -l < geo_genes.txt
  printf 'gene_intersection_count='; wc -l < gene_intersection.txt
  printf 'gene_h5_only_count='; wc -l < gene_h5_only.txt
  printf 'gene_geo_only_count='; wc -l < gene_geo_only.txt
  echo 'h5_genes_first5'; head -n 5 h5_genes.txt
  echo 'geo_genes_first5'; head -n 5 geo_genes.txt
} > comparison_summary.txt
